home.label: Home ground
home.job: A side's base and safe economy

variants.choice: Safe ground: walls {wall} bands high; all traffic leaves by the gate.
Safe ground on a plateau {wall} bands up; the gate is the only stair.
Safe ground in a river bend; the river is {wall} bands of cover on three sides.

gate.label: Gate
gate.job: The way out of home ground

variants.choice: One {width} wu mouth: easy to leave, easy to be seen leaving.
Two {width} wu mouths: split out, or hold both with one force.
A {width} wu mouth under a ridge: whoever holds the ridge sees every exit.
Hold here: about {fire} can fire at once; the way round is {extra} s longer.
Two chokes, one half-hidden: watch both or lose the second; the way round is {extra} s longer.
Climb: {band} bands up it looks down the road; two ways up, one {extra} s longer.
Hold the stair: a strongpoint {band} bands up covers the road below.
A hill overlooking the crossing: take it before the crossing, or be shot crossing.

prize.label: Prize
prize.job: A resource worth leaving the main line for

variants.choice: A dead-end pocket {spur} s off the road: take it and commit.
A pocket with a back door: hold the front and the raid still comes round.
Open ground {spur} s off a raid lane: cheap to take, cheap to lose.

commons.label: Commons
commons.job: Open contested ground where formation decides

variants.choice: Open plain {width} wu wide: formation and numbers decide.
Plain broken by tall cover: fight from behind it or flank around it.
A neutral settlement on open ground: whoever holds it feeds there.

objective.label: Objective ground
objective.job: Where the objective sits or travels

variants.choice: The objective with {approaches} approaches: one is hidden, so watch them all.
The objective on an open crossing: strong to hold, hard to reinforce.
The objective is on the move: be where it will be, not where it is.

hidden.label: Hidden approach
hidden.job: A second way in, out of sight of the first

variants.choice: A {width} wu way in, out of sight of the main road: watch it or be flanked.
